sonnet.problem: This story card says 'His name is blasphemed continually all day long.' The next choice card (card 11) asks what the people will know about the LORD, and the right answer is 'name'. The word 'name' is handed over right before the question, so the answer is given away.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The story card says the LORD has bared His arm 'in the sight of all the nations' and adds 'Front-row seats for everybody.' Card 10 is a True statement that all the ends of the earth will see God's salvation. The setup makes the True answer obvious, and card 10 only repeats the same point.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.

sonnet.problem: The right answer 'unclean' was already shown in Stop 2 card 3, in the question about 'the uncircumcised and unclean'. The word is in view before this blank, so the answer is given away, and the wrong answers ('heavy', 'costly') are weak next to it.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
